requirement: A guest cancelling before the stated deadline gets the entire amount paid back as money, with no retained fee.
meaning_constraints: Use varied explicit counterexamples: voucher only; retained handling fee; only partial refund; deposit forfeited; non-refundable advance purchase; money never returned even before the cutoff.

clauses.rationale: The text explicitly guarantees a full cash refund upon timely cancellation.

clauses.rationale: This confirms the refund will be in money and no fees are deducted for early cancellation.

clauses.text: Cancelling by the deadline ensures all monies paid are returned to you; partial refunds are only issued if the cancellation is extremely late.
